kv15.9:1.3: Atthi saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpannassa maraṇantiyo phasso, maraṇantiyā vedanā, maraṇantiyā saññā, maraṇantiyā cetanā, maraṇantiyaṃ cittan ti?
kv15.9:1.5: N' atthi saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpannassa marāṇantiyo phasso --pe-- maraṇantiyaṃ cittan ti?
kv15.9:1.7: Hañci n' atthi saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpannassa maraṇantiyaṃ cittaṃ, no vata re vattabbe
kv15.9:2.3: Atthi saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpannassa phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittan ti?
kv15.9:2.5: N' atthi saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpannassa phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittan ti?
kv15.9:2.7: Aphassakassa kālakiriyā, avedanakassa kālakiriyā -- pe -- acittakassa kālakiriyā ti?
kv15.9:2.9: Nanu saphassakassa kālakiriyā --pe-- sacittakassa kālakiriyā ti?
kv15.9:2.11: Hañci saphassakassa kālakiriyā --pe-- sacittakassa kālakiriyā, no vata re vattabbe
kv15.9:3.3: Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpannassa kāye visaṃ kameyya, satthaṃ kameyya, aggi kameyyāti?
kv15.9:3.5: Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpannassa kāye visaṃ na kameyya, satthaṃ na kameyya, aggi na kameyyāti?
kv15.9:3.7: Hañci aggi na kameyya, no vata re vattabbe
kv15.9:4.3: kāye visaṃ kameyya, satthaṃ kameyya, aggi kameyyāti?
kv15.9:5.3: Atthi so niyāmo yena niyāmena niyato saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpanno na kālaṃ kareyyāti?
kv15.9:5.5: Hañci n' atthi so niyāmo yena niyāmena niyato saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpanno na kālaṃ kareyya, no vata re vattabbe
kv15.9:6.3: Atthi so niyāmo yena niyāmena niyato cakkhuviññāṇasamaṅgī na kālaṃ kareyyāti?
kv15.9:6.5: Hañci n' atthi so niyāmo yena niyāmena niyato cakkhuviññāṇasamaṅgī na kālaṃ kareyya, no vata re vattabbe
